entry.name: Issue #90 is closed by the merged change
entry.expected: The landing PR body carries `Fixes #90`, and #90 shows closed on GitHub once that PR merges
entry.why_human: Out-of-reach resource: the landing PR does not exist yet (the work sits unmerged on traders), and reading a PR body and an issue's state means querying GitHub over the network, which this pass may not do. Code inspection cannot settle it.
